category_title: Low-achieving students in inclusive settings who exhibit superficial responses or off-task behavior when objectives are unclear
minimal_context: The student is working on an anticipation-reaction guide and examining photographs and resource maps of different countries in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, look at your anticipation-reaction guides. For each statement, you need to check 'Agree' or 'Disagree' based on the photographs and resource maps.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Are we supposed to write that down? We don't have nothin' in the box right here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, if you need to write something, write it on the back. Let's look at the pictures of the countries.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We have a lot of stuff in this one. That one's clean. The other ones, they're wiggity-wack. Jobs don't pay as much.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, look at number 2 on your guide.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: So, what is it? We don't know. It's like court. (The student mouths and pantomimes a debate)

task.content: Working on an anticipation-reaction guide where students must check 'Agree' or 'Disagree' for statements and provide evidence, and examining photographs and resource maps of different countries to identify characteristics of developed and developing nations.
task.learning_goal: Tell what makes a country be considered developed or developing and explain how the natural resources affect that

context.materials: Anticipation-reaction guide, photographs and resource maps of different countries, board
context.social_setting: Interactive group activity and whole-class activity
context.time_context: At the beginning of a lesson

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Introduced the lesson with thorough directions about the mechanics of the activity, to the exclusion of explaining the connection to the objective.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Students displayed an understanding of how they were supposed to behave, but they still seemed interested in knowing why they were participating in justifying their opinions. The student mouths and pantomimes a debate.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Confused about the academic goal and attempted to determine it themselves.
related_quotes: We don't have nothin' in the box right here

behavior_patterns.condition: When the teacher only states the objective at the beginning without connecting it to activities.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Their responses throughout the activity were short, superficial, and largely unrelated to the expectation.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Not sure what to make of the teacher's new approach to starting the lesson, nor did they understand how to use the stated objective to support their learning.
related_quotes: Are we supposed to write that down?
We have a lot of stuff
